modules.title: Introduction to Internet and Communication
modules.html:
Browsers, email, search engines and e-commerce. This section covers introduction to internet and communication.

Key points

  • Which of the following is used to uniquely identify a computer on the internet — IP Address.
  • Which device connects a computer to the internet — Modem.
  • Internet is: — Network of networks.
  • Which of the following is used to browse the internet — Firefox.
  • Internet: — Network of networks.

Worked examples

Q: Which of the following is used to uniquely identify a computer on the internet?
A: IP Address — An IP Address is a numerical label assigned to each device participating in a computer network that uses the Internet Protocol.

Q: Which device connects a computer to the internet?
A: Modem — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Modem.

examples.q: Which of the following is used to uniquely identify a computer on the internet?
Which device connects a computer to the internet?

quiz.q: In HTML, which tag is used to create a hyperlink?
quiz.solution: The <a> (anchor) tag is used to define a hyperlink, which links one page to another.

quiz.q: An 8-bit byte can represent _____ different values.
quiz.solution: 2 raised to the power of 8 (2^8) equals 256.

quiz.q: The decimal equivalent of hexadecimal 'A' is _____.
